svg.title: DevFlow development lifecycle
svg.desc: DevFlow is a standalone, development-time Codex CLI workflow, separate from the WordPilot runtime. Stages: developer initiation, environment preflight, task definition, human approval, workspace preparation, Codex execution, host diff review, verification and reporting.
svg.text: Stages and transitions as implemented in dev_workflow/ (graph.py, __main__.py, preflight.py, worktree.py, verification.py, reporting.py)
DEVELOPMENT-TIME TOOLING — SEPARATE FROM WORDPILOT RUNTIME
Standalone Codex CLI workflow for software engineering tasks: planning, isolated execution, verification and reporting. It never handles WordPilot users' documents.
Start a task from the CLI
menu or resume a saved run
request changes: re-analyse with feedback (bounded, default max 2)
the decision is bound to the
LangGraph checkpoints each run in SQLite (.devflow/checkpoints.sqlite3).
Approval pauses the run; it resumes from the saved run via the CLI menu.
Evidence-based report built from checkpointed state: decisions, implementation, diff and check results.
Every terminal path ends here. Success requires approval, a valid diff and all required checks passed.
Not implemented as workflow stages: independent code-review stage, automated review-and-correction loop, graphical approval UI. The only retry loop is bounded proposal revision.
No dependency: WordPilot does not import, call or deploy DevFlow
WORDPILOT RUNTIME — DELIVERED DOCUMENT-EDITING PRODUCT (context only)
Handles end users' document-editing instructions. The Vercel deployment configuration excludes dev_workflow/.
